Q: A stem-and-leaf diagram has stem 4 and leaves 2, 5, 7, 8. What are the actual data values if the key is 4 | 2 means 42?
Q: In a Venn diagram, set A has 20 elements, set B has 15 elements, and A ∩ B has 8 elements. How many elements are in A ∪ B?
Q: A pictogram uses one circle to represent 10 cars. How many circles represent 35 cars?

points.text: 3 whole circles and one half circle, since 35 ÷ 10 = 3.5.

questions.question: Q: What does a wide base on a population pyramid indicate?

points.text: A wide base indicates a high birth rate, meaning a large proportion of the population is in the youngest age groups.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response The table shows the number of students in each year group at a school. Draw a pie chart to represent the data. Year 7: 130, Year 8: 120, Year 9: 110, Year 10: 100, Year 11: 90 <div class="

points.text: Total = 130 + 120 + 110 + 100 + 90 = 550 Year 7: (130 ÷ 550) × 360° = 85.1° Year 8: (120 ÷ 550) × 360° = 78.5° Year 9: (110 ÷ 550) × 360° = 72.0° Year 10: (100 ÷ 550) × 360° = 65.5° Year 11: (90 ÷ 550) × 360° = 58.9° Check: 85.1 + 78.5 + 72.0 + 65.5 + 58.9 = 360.0° Draw a circle, draw a radius, then measure each angle in order using a protractor. Label each sector with the year group and angle.
